323	def _parse_matcher(raw: object, what: str) -> _Matcher:
324	    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
325	        raise ValueError(f"{what} must be an object")
326	    keys = set(raw)
327	    if keys == {"values"}:
328	        values = raw["values"]
329	        if not isinstance(values, list) or not values:
330	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.values must be a non-empty array")
331	        if any(not _is_int(item) for item in values):
332	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.values must contain only integers")
333	        return _Matcher("status", None, None, frozenset(values))
334	    if keys == {"name", "operator", "value"}:
335	        kind = "header"
336	        name = raw["name"]
337	        if not isinstance(name, str):
338	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.name must be a string")
339	    elif keys == {"operator", "value"}:
340	        kind = "body"
341	        name = None
342	    else:
343	        raise ValueError(f"{what} has unknown or missing fields")
344	    operator = raw["operator"]
345	    if operator not in OPERATORS:
346	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.operator must be one of {OPERATORS}")
347	    value = raw["value"]
348	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
349	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.value must be a non-empty string")
350	    regex = None
351	    if operator == "regex":
352	        try:
353	            regex = re.compile(value)
354	        except re.error as exc:
355	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.value is an invalid regex: {exc}") from exc
356	    return _Matcher(kind, name, operator, value, regex)

958	def _render_payload_template(template: str, variables: dict[str, str], what: str) -> str:
959	    """Substitute ${name} placeholders exactly once.
960	
961	    Variable values are inserted verbatim and never re-scanned, so a value
962	    containing placeholders is not expanded. A missing reference, an unused
963	    variable, or a malformed placeholder makes the request invalid.
964	    """
965	    parts: list[str] = []
966	    referenced: set[str] = set()
967	    index = 0
968	    length = len(template)
969	    while index < length:
970	        if template[index] == "$" and index + 1 < length and template[index + 1] == "{":
971	            end = template.find("}", index + 2)
972	            if end == -1:
973	                raise ValueError(f"{what}.template has a malformed placeholder")
974	            name = template[index + 2 : end]
975	            if not _VARIABLE_NAME_RE.fullmatch(name) or name not in variables:
976	                raise ValueError(
977	                    f"{what}.template has a malformed or unresolved placeholder"
978	                )
979	            parts.append(variables[name])
980	            referenced.add(name)
981	            index = end + 1
982	        else:
983	            parts.append(template[index])
984	            index += 1
985	    unused = set(variables) - referenced
986	    if unused:
987	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.variables has unused variable: {sorted(unused)[0]!r}")
988	    return "".join(parts)
989

994	    raw_steps = obj["steps"]

997	    steps: list[str] = []
998	    for step in raw_steps:

1000	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.steps has an unknown step: {step!r}")
1001	        steps.append(step)

1008	    item_id = _non_empty_str(obj["id"], f"{what}.id")
1009	    template = _non_empty_str(obj["template"], f"{what}.template")
1010	    raw_variables = obj["variables"]
1011	    if not isinstance(raw_variables, dict):
1012	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.variables must be an object")
1013	    variables: dict[str, str] = {}
1014	    for name, value in raw_variables.items():

1016	            raise ValueError(f"{what}.variables has invalid variable name: {name!r}")
1017	        if not isinstance(value, str):

1019	        variables[name] = value
1020	    raw_variants = obj["variants"]
1021	    if not isinstance(raw_variants, list):
1022	        raise ValueError(f"{what}.variants must be an array")
1023	    variants = [

1406	def _jcs_number(value: float) -> str:
1407	    """Serialize a float the way ECMAScript's Number::toString does (JCS).
1408	
1409	    RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3 adopts the ES2018 algorithm (with the Note 2
1410	    enhancement): the shortest round-trippable decimal, fixed notation for
1411	    -6 <= exponent <= 20, scientific otherwise (the exponent sign is kept,
1412	    e.g. 1e+21), and -0 rendered as 0.
1413	    """
1414	    if isinstance(value, int):
1415	        value = float(value)
1416	    if value == 0:
1417	        return "0"
1418	    text = repr(value)
1419	    mantissa, _, exponent = text.partition("e")
1420	    if exponent:
1421	        exp = int(exponent)
1422	        text = mantissa
1423	    else:
1424	        exp = 0
1425	    negative = text.startswith("-")
1426	    if negative:
1427	        text = text[1:]
1428	    int_part, _, frac_part = text.partition(".")
1429	    # repr() tags an integral float with ".0"; those zeros are formatting,
1430	    # not significant digits of the shortest round-trip representation.
1431	    frac_part = frac_part.rstrip("0")
1432	    digits = (int_part + frac_part).lstrip("0")
1433	    int_digits = int_part.lstrip("0")
1434	    if int_digits:
1435	        # Exponent of the most significant digit in the integer part.
1436	        n = len(int_digits) - 1 + exp
1437	    else:
1438	        # First significant digit sits after the point; count leading zeros.
1439	        leading_zeros = len(frac_part) - len(frac_part.lstrip("0"))
1440	        n = -leading_zeros - 1 + exp
1441	    decimal_at = n + 1  # number of significant digits before the point
1442	
1443	    if -6 <= n <= 20:
1444	        if decimal_at <= 0:
1445	            result = "0." + "0" * (-decimal_at) + digits
1446	        elif decimal_at >= len(digits):
1447	            result = digits + "0" * (decimal_at - len(digits))
1448	        else:
1449	            result = digits[:decimal_at] + "." + digits[decimal_at:]
1450	    else:
1451	        head = digits[0]
1452	        rest = digits[1:]
1453	        coefficient = head + ("." + rest if rest else "")
1454	        result = f"{coefficient}e{n:+d}"
1455	    return "-" + result if negative else result

1458	def _jcs_escape(text: str) -> str:
1459	    """Escape a JSON string per JCS: minimal escapes, lowercase hex."""
1460	    pieces = ['"']
1461	    for char in text:
1462	        codepoint = ord(char)
1463	        if char == '"':
1464	            pieces.append('\\"')
1465	        elif char == "\\":
1466	            pieces.append("\\\\")
1467	        elif codepoint == 0x08:
1468	            pieces.append("\\b")
1469	        elif codepoint == 0x0C:
1470	            pieces.append("\\f")
1471	        elif codepoint == 0x0A:
1472	            pieces.append("\\n")
1473	        elif codepoint == 0x0D:
1474	            pieces.append("\\r")
1475	        elif codepoint == 0x09:
1476	            pieces.append("\\t")
1477	        elif codepoint < 0x20:
1478	            pieces.append(f"\\u{codepoint:04x}")
1479	        else:
1480	            pieces.append(char)
1481	    pieces.append('"')
1482	    return "".join(pieces)

1491	def _jcs_serialize(value: object) -> str:
1492	    """Serialize a JSON-compatible Python value per RFC 8785."""
1493	    if value is None:
1494	        return "null"
1495	    if value is True:
1496	        return "true"
1497	    if value is False:
1498	        return "false"
1499	    if isinstance(value, str):
1500	        return _jcs_escape(value)
1501	    if isinstance(value, int):
1502	        return _jcs_number(float(value))
1503	    if isinstance(value, float):
1504	        if math.isnan(value) or math.isinf(value):
1505	            raise ValueError("NaN and Infinity are not representable in JSON")
1506	        return _jcs_number(value)
1507	    if isinstance(value, dict):
1508	        members = []
1509	        for key in sorted(value, key=_jcs_sort_key):
1510	            if not isinstance(key, str):
1511	                raise ValueError("object keys must be strings")
1512	            members.append(_jcs_escape(key) + ":" + _jcs_serialize(value[key]))
1513	        return "{" + ",".join(members) + "}"
1514	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
1515	        return "[" + ",".join(_jcs_serialize(item) for item in value) + "]"
1516	    raise ValueError(f"value is not JSON-compatible: {type(value).__name__}")

1541	        """Evaluate targets against allow/deny scope rules.

1547	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
1548	            raise ValueError("payload must be an object")

1550	        for key in ("allow", "deny", "targets"):
1551	            if key not in payload:

1555	            if not isinstance(value, list):
1556	                raise ValueError(f"field {key} must be an array")
1557	            if len(value) > MAX_RULES_PER_FIELD:
1558	                raise ValueError(
1559	                    f"field {key} exceeds {MAX_RULES_PER_FIELD} entries"
1560	                )

1562	            raise ValueError("targets must not be empty")
1563

1565	            _parse_entry(raw, allow_wildcard=True) for raw in fields["allow"]
1566	        ]
1567	        deny_rules = [
1568	            _parse_entry(raw, allow_wildcard=True) for raw in fields["deny"]
1569	        ]
1570	        decisions = [

1576	    def _decide(
1577	        self,
1578	        raw_target: object,
1579	        allow_rules: list[_Entry],
1580	        deny_rules: list[_Entry],
1581	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1582	        target = _parse_entry(raw_target, allow_wildcard=False)
1583	        allowed, reason, matched_rule = self._evaluate(
1584	            target, allow_rules, deny_rules

1588	    def _evaluate(
1589	        self,
1590	        target: _Entry,
1591	        allow_rules: list[_Entry],
1592	        deny_rules: list[_Entry],
1593	    ) -> tuple[bool, str, str | None]:
1594	        """Decide a parsed target; return (allowed, reason, matched_rule)."""
1595	        if target.kind == "network":
1596	            # A CIDR target needs full containment in an allow network and
1597	            # must not intersect any deny network.
1598	            for rule in deny_rules:
1599	                if (
1600	                    rule.kind == "network"
1601	                    and rule.value.version == target.value.version
1602	                    and target.value.overlaps(rule.value)
1603	                ):
1604	                    return False, "deny_overlap", rule.text
1605	            for rule in allow_rules:
1606	                if (
1607	                    rule.kind == "network"
1608	                    and rule.value.version == target.value.version
1609	                    and target.value.subnet_of(rule.value)
1610	                ):
1611	                    return True, "allowed", rule.text
1612	            return False, "no_allow_match", None
1613	        # Deny wins over allow for point targets.
1614	        for rule in deny_rules:
1615	            if _matches(rule, target):
1616	                return False, "deny_match", rule.text
1617	        for rule in allow_rules:
1618	            if _matches(rule, target):
1619	                return True, "allowed", rule.text
1620	        return False, "no_allow_match", None

2444	    @staticmethod
2445	    def _check_report_consistency(
2446	        findings: list[_ConsolidatedItem],
2447	        comparisons: list[_Comparison],
2448	        plans: list[_Plan],
2449	    ) -> None:
2450	        """Cross-validate keys and names across the three result arrays."""
2451	        names: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
2452	
2453	        def register_name(key: tuple[str, str], name: str) -> None:
2454	            known = names.get(key)
2455	            if known is None:
2456	                names[key] = name
2457	            elif known != name:
2458	                raise ValueError(
2459	                    f"conflicting names for ({key[0]!r}, {key[1]!r}): "
2460	                    f"{known!r} vs {name!r}"
2461	                )
2462	
2463	        finding_by_key: dict[tuple[str, str], _ConsolidatedItem] = {}
2464	        for item in findings:
2465	            key = (item.target.text, item.template_id)
2466	            if key in finding_by_key:
2467	                raise ValueError(
2468	                    f"duplicate finding key: ({key[0]!r}, {key[1]!r})"
2469	                )
2470	            finding_by_key[key] = item
2471	            register_name(key, item.name)
2472	
2473	        comparison_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
2474	        after_keys: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
2475	        for comparison in comparisons:
2476	            key = (comparison.target.text, comparison.template_id)
2477	            if key in comparison_keys:
2478	                raise ValueError(
2479	                    f"duplicate comparison key: ({key[0]!r}, {key[1]!r})"
2480	                )
2481	            comparison_keys.add(key)
2482	            register_name(key, comparison.name)
2483	            if comparison.before is not None:
2484	                register_name(key, comparison.before.name)
2485	            if comparison.after is not None:
2486	                after_keys.add(key)
2487	                register_name(key, comparison.after.name)
2488	
2489	        if comparisons:
2490	            # A non-null after must be the exact current finding for its
2491	            # key, and every current finding must be compared.
2492	            for comparison in comparisons:
2493	                if comparison.after is None:
2494	                    continue
2495	                key = (comparison.target.text, comparison.template_id)
2496	                current = finding_by_key.get(key)
2497	                if current is None or current != comparison.after:
2498	                    raise ValueError(
2499	                        "comparison after does not match the current finding "
2500	                        f"for key ({key[0]!r}, {key[1]!r})"
2501	                    )
2502	            for key in finding_by_key:
2503	                if key not in after_keys:
2504	                    raise ValueError(
2505	                        "current finding not covered by comparisons: "
2506	                        f"({key[0]!r}, {key[1]!r})"
2507	                    )
2508	
2509	        finding_targets = {item.target.text for item in findings}
2510	        plan_targets: set[str] = set()
2511	        for plan in plans:
2512	            target = plan.target.text
2513	            if target in plan_targets:
2514	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate plan target: {target!r}")
2515	            plan_targets.add(target)
2516	            if target not in finding_targets:
2517	                raise ValueError(
2518	                    f"plan target has no current findings: {target!r}"
2519	                )

2847	    @staticmethod
2848	    def _best_escalation_path(
2849	        goal: _EscalationGoal,
2850	        sessions_by_id: dict[str, _EscalationSession],
2851	        outgoing: dict[str, list[_EscalationTransition]],
2852	        start_pos: dict[str, int],
2853	        session_pos: dict[str, int],
2854	        transition_pos: dict[str, int],
2855	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
2856	        """Multi-source Dijkstra ordered by the full path tie-break tuple.
2857	
2858	        A route label is (total cost, transition count, start input position,
2859	        tuple of transition input positions, end session input position).
2860	        Every transition adds positive cost, so labels strictly grow along an
2861	        edge and the heap settles routes in non-decreasing label order; the
2862	        first settled session that satisfies the goal carries the best label,
2863	        since replacing a node's prefix by a smaller label keeps every suffix
2864	        comparison smaller.
2865	        """
2866	        goal_rank = _PRIVILEGE_RANK[goal.min_privilege]
2867	        goal_text = goal.target.text
2868	
2869	        def satisfies(session: _EscalationSession) -> bool:
2870	            return (
2871	                session.target.text == goal_text
2872	                and _PRIVILEGE_RANK[session.privilege] >= goal_rank
2873	            )
2874	
2875	        # label[node] is the smallest label of a route reaching the node;
2876	        # parent[node] is the (incoming transition, predecessor) of that route.
2877	        labels: dict[str, tuple[Any, ...]] = {}
2878	        parent: dict[str, tuple[_EscalationTransition, str] | None] = {}
2879	        heap: list[tuple[Any, ...]] = []
2880	        for start_id, start_index in start_pos.items():
2881	            label = (0, 0, start_index, (), session_pos[start_id])
2882	            labels[start_id] = label
2883	            parent[start_id] = None
2884	            heapq.heappush(heap, label + (start_id,))
2885	
2886	        answer_node: str | None = None
2887	        while heap:
2888	            entry = heapq.heappop(heap)
2889	            label = entry[:-1]
2890	            node = entry[-1]
2891	            if labels.get(node) != label:
2892	                continue  # superseded by a smaller label for the same node
2893	            if satisfies(sessions_by_id[node]):
2894	                answer_node = node
2895	                break
2896	            for transition in outgoing[node]:
2897	                neighbor = transition.destination
2898	                new_label = (
2899	                    label[0] + transition.cost,
2900	                    label[1] + 1,
2901	                    label[2],

3119	    @staticmethod
3120	    def _resolve_request_order(
3121	        requests: list[_ScheduledRequest],
3122	    ) -> list[_ScheduledRequest]:
3123	        """Topologically order requests; same level keeps input order.
3124	
3125	        Raises ValueError on self-references, unknown ids, or cycles.
3126	        """
3127	        known = {request.id for request in requests}
3128	        for request in requests:
3129	            for dep in request.depends_on:
3130	                if dep == request.id:
3131	                    raise ValueError(
3132	                        f"request {request.id!r} depends on itself"
3133	                    )
3134	                if dep not in known:
3135	                    raise ValueError(
3136	                        f"request {request.id!r} depends on unknown id: "
3137	                        f"{dep!r}"
3138	                    )
3139	        remaining = list(requests)
3140	        done: set[str] = set()
3141	        ordered: list[_ScheduledRequest] = []
3142	        while remaining:
3143	            ready_now = [
3144	                request
3145	                for request in remaining
3146	                if all(dep in done for dep in request.depends_on)
3147	            ]
3148	            if not ready_now:
3149	                raise ValueError("request dependencies form a cycle")
3150	            for request in ready_now:
3151	                done.add(request.id)
3152	            ordered.extend(ready_now)
3153	            remaining = [
3154	                request for request in remaining if request.id not in done
3155	            ]
3156	        return ordered

3158	    @staticmethod
3159	    def _build_schedule(
3160	        ordered_requests: list[_ScheduledRequest],
3161	        policy: _RateLimitPolicy,
3162	        input_positions: dict[str, int],
3163	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
3164	        """Place each request into the earliest non-saturated fixed window.
3165	
3166	        Candidates are walked in stable topological order, so input position
3167	        decides every occupancy tie. Per group, each fixed window holds at
3168	        most max_requests placements; a full window pushes the request to
3169	        the next window start.
3170	        """
3171	        window_ms = policy.window_ms
3172	        max_requests = policy.max_requests
3173	        scheduled_at: dict[str, int] = {}
3174	        # group -> {window_start: [request id, ...]} in placement order.
3175	        occupancy: dict[Any, dict[int, list[str]]] = {}
3176	        results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
3177	
3178	        for request in ordered_requests:
3179	            candidate = request.earliest_ms
3180	            for dep in request.depends_on:
3181	                if scheduled_at[dep] > candidate:
3182	                    candidate = scheduled_at[dep]
3183	            group: Any
3184	            if policy.group_by == "target_route":
3185	                group = (request.target.text, request.route)
3186	            else:
3187	                group = request.target.text
3188	            group_windows = occupancy.setdefault(group, {})
3189	            window_start = (candidate // window_ms) * window_ms
3190	            candidate_window = window_start
3191	            while len(group_windows.get(window_start, ())) >= max_requests:
3192	                window_start += window_ms
3193	            group_windows.setdefault(window_start, []).append(request.id)
3194	            # Room in the candidate's own window: execute at the candidate
3195	            # time; a bumped request executes at the next window start.
3196	            scheduled_ms = (
3197	                candidate if window_start == candidate_window else window_start
3198	            )
3199	            scheduled_at[request.id] = scheduled_ms
3200	            results.append(
3201	                {
3202	                    "id": request.id,
3203	                    "target": request.target.text,
3204	                    "route": request.route,
3205	                    "scheduled_ms": scheduled_ms,
3206	                    "window_start_ms": window_start,
3207	                    "depends_on": list(request.depends_on),
3208	                    "_pos": input_positions[request.id],
3209	                }
3210	            )
3211	        return results

3697	    def _hsts_effective(headers: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]) -> bool:
3698	        """Whether any Strict-Transport-Security value enables HSTS.
3699	
3700	        The value is split on semicolons; a directive named max-age
3701	        (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed) is effective only when the
3702	        text right of '=' consists solely of ASCII decimal digits, at least
3703	        one of them non-zero. Anything else, including missing '=' or
3704	        surrounding whitespace on the age, is treated as malformed. The
3705	        numeric test is purely lexical so even an oversized digit run cannot
3706	        raise.
3707	        """
3708	        for value in Service._header_values_ci(
3709	            headers, "strict-transport-security"
3710	        ):
3711	            for directive in value.split(";"):
3712	                name, sep, raw_age = directive.partition("=")
3713	                if not sep or name.strip().lower() != "max-age":
3714	                    continue
3715	                if (
3716	                    raw_age
3717	                    and all(char in _ASCII_DIGITS for char in raw_age)
3718	                    and any(char != "0" for char in raw_age)
3719	                ):
3720	                    return True
3721	        return False

import json
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer

from redforge.server import Handler
from redforge.service import ScopeViolationError, Service


def make_finding(**overrides):
    finding = {
        "target": "app.example.com",
        "template_id": "tpl-1",
        "name": "Demo template",
        "severity": "high",
        "observation_ids": ["obs-1"],
        "sources": ["run-1"],
        "evidence": [0],
        "confidence": 80,
    }
    finding.update(overrides)
    return finding


def make_requirement(**overrides):
    requirement = {
        "template_id": "tpl-1",
        "min_severity": "medium",
        "min_confidence": 50,
    }
    requirement.update(overrides)
    return requirement


def make_stage(**overrides):
    stage = {
        "id": "stage-1",
        "name": "Initial access",
        "logic": "all",
        "requires": [make_requirement()],
        "depends_on": [],
    }
    stage.update(overrides)
    return stage


def plan_payload(**overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com"],
        "deny": [],
        "findings": [make_finding()],
        "stages": [make_stage()],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


class PlanServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.service = Service()

    def plan(self, **overrides):
        return self.service.plan_attack_chains(plan_payload(**overrides))

    def test_ready_stage(self):
        result = self.plan()
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["plans"])
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(list(plan), ["target", "stages"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["target"], "app.example.com")
        (stage,) = plan["stages"]
        self.assertEqual(list(stage), ["id", "name", "status", "reason"])
        self.assertEqual(
            stage,
            {
                "id": "stage-1",
                "name": "Initial access",
                "status": "ready",
                "reason": None,
            },
        )

    def test_empty_findings_returns_empty_plans(self):
        result = self.plan(findings=[])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"plans": []})

    def test_missing_requirements_when_thresholds_not_met(self):
        result = self.plan(findings=[make_finding(severity="low")])
        (stage,) = result["plans"][0]["stages"]
        self.assertEqual(stage["status"], "skipped")
        self.assertEqual(stage["reason"], "missing_requirements")
        result = self.plan(findings=[make_finding(confidence=10)])
        (stage,) = result["plans"][0]["stages"]
        self.assertEqual(stage["status"], "skipped")
        self.assertEqual(stage["reason"], "missing_requirements")

    def test_template_id_match_is_case_sensitive(self):
        result = self.plan(findings=[make_finding(template_id="TPL-1")])
        (stage,) = result["plans"][0]["stages"]
        self.assertEqual(stage["status"], "skipped")
        self.assertEqual(stage["reason"], "missing_requirements")

    def test_requirements_only_match_same_target(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[make_finding(target="other.example.com")],
            stages=[
                make_stage(id="s1", name="A"),
                make_stage(id="s2", name="B", depends_on=["s1"]),
            ],
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["target"], "other.example.com")
        self.assertEqual(
            [(s["status"], s["reason"]) for s in plan["stages"]],
            [("ready", None), ("ready", None)],
        )

    def test_dependency_blocked(self):
        stages = [
            make_stage(
                id="s1",
                name="A",
                requires=[make_requirement(template_id="absent")],
            ),
            make_stage(id="s2", name="B", depends_on=["s1"]),
        ]
        result = self.plan(stages=stages)
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(
            [(s["status"], s["reason"]) for s in plan["stages"]],
            [("skipped", "missing_requirements"), ("skipped", "dependency_blocked")],
        )

    def test_blocked_dependency_propagates_transitively(self):
        stages = [
            make_stage(
                id="s1",
                name="A",
                requires=[make_requirement(template_id="absent")],
            ),
            make_stage(id="s2", name="B", depends_on=["s1"]),
            make_stage(id="s3", name="C", depends_on=["s2"]),
        ]
        result = self.plan(stages=stages)
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(
            [s["reason"] for s in plan["stages"]],
            ["missing_requirements", "dependency_blocked", "dependency_blocked"],
        )

    def test_logic_any_matches_one_requirement(self):
        stage = make_stage(
            logic="any",
            requires=[
                make_requirement(template_id="absent"),
                make_requirement(template_id="tpl-1"),
            ],
        )
        result = self.plan(stages=[stage])
        (stage_result,) = result["plans"][0]["stages"]
        self.assertEqual(stage_result["status"], "ready")

    def test_logic_all_requires_every_requirement(self):
        stage = make_stage(
            logic="all",
            requires=[
                make_requirement(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_requirement(template_id="absent"),
            ],
        )
        result = self.plan(stages=[stage])
        (stage_result,) = result["plans"][0]["stages"]
        self.assertEqual(stage_result["status"], "skipped")
        self.assertEqual(stage_result["reason"], "missing_requirements")

    def test_targets_keep_first_occurrence_order(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(target="b.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="a.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="b.example.com", template_id="tpl-2"),
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [plan["target"] for plan in result["plans"]],
            ["b.example.com", "a.example.com"],
        )

    def test_normalized_target_groups_findings(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(target="APP.Example.COM.", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="app.example.com", template_id="tpl-2"),
            ]
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["target"], "app.example.com")

    def test_same_level_stages_keep_input_order(self):
        stages = [
            make_stage(id="s3", name="C", depends_on=["s1", "s2"]),
            make_stage(id="s1", name="A"),
            make_stage(id="s2", name="B"),
        ]
        result = self.plan(stages=stages)
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual([s["id"] for s in plan["stages"]], ["s1", "s2", "s3"])

    def test_duplicate_finding_key_is_invalid(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[make_finding(), make_finding(name="Other name")]
            )
        # The same key reached through different target spellings counts too.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[
                    make_finding(),
                    make_finding(target="APP.Example.COM."),
                ]
            )

    def test_scope_violation_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ScopeViolationError):
            self.plan(findings=[make_finding(target="evil.net")])
        with self.assertRaises(ScopeViolationError):
            self.plan(deny=["app.example.com"])

    def test_structure_validated_before_scope_gate(self):
        # A duplicate finding key is a 400 even though a target is out of
        # scope.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[make_finding(target="evil.net"), make_finding(target="evil.net")]
            )
        # A broken dependency graph is a 400 too.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[make_finding(target="evil.net")],
                stages=[make_stage(depends_on=["nope"])],
            )

    def test_stage_dependency_validation(self):
        bad_stages = [
            [make_stage(depends_on=["stage-1"])],  # self reference
            [make_stage(depends_on=["ghost"])],  # unknown id
            [make_stage(depends_on=["a", "a"])],  # duplicate entry
            [make_stage(id="a"), make_stage(id="a")],  # duplicate stage id
            [
                make_stage(id="a", depends_on=["b"]),
                make_stage(id="b", depends_on=["a"]),
            ],  # cycle
            [
                make_stage(id="a", depends_on=["c"]),
                make_stage(id="b", depends_on=["a"]),
                make_stage(id="c", depends_on=["b"]),
            ],  # longer cycle
        ]
        for stages in bad_stages:
            with self.subTest(stages=stages):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    self.plan(stages=stages)

    def test_validation_errors(self):
        bad_payloads = [
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"allow": [], "deny": [], "findings": []},
            plan_payload(extra=1),
            plan_payload(allow="*.example.com"),
            plan_payload(deny=1),
            plan_payload(findings={}),
            plan_payload(findings="x"),
            plan_payload(findings=[None]),
            plan_payload(findings=[{"target": "app.example.com"}]),
            plan_payload(findings=[make_finding(extra=1)]),
            plan_payload(findings=[make_finding(severity="fatal")]),
            plan_payload(findings=[make_finding(confidence=101)]),
            plan_payload(findings=[make_finding(confidence=True)]),
            plan_payload(stages=[]),
            plan_payload(stages={}),
            plan_payload(stages="x"),
            plan_payload(stages=[None]),
            plan_payload(stages=[{"id": "s1"}]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(extra=1)]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(id="")]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(id=3)]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(name="")]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(name=1)]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(logic="all!")]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(logic="ALL")]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(requires=[])]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(requires="x")]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(requires=[{}])]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(extra=1)])]),
            plan_payload(
                stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(template_id="")])]
            ),
            plan_payload(
                stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(min_severity="fatal")])]
            ),
            plan_payload(
                stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(min_confidence=-1)])]
            ),
            plan_payload(
                stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(min_confidence=101)])]
            ),
            plan_payload(
                stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(min_confidence=True)])]
            ),
            plan_payload(
                stages=[make_stage(requires=[make_requirement(min_confidence=1.5)])]
            ),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(depends_on="s1")]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(depends_on=[1])]),
            plan_payload(stages=[make_stage(depends_on=[""])]),
        ]
        for payload in bad_payloads:
            with self.subTest(payload=repr(payload)[:90]):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    self.service.plan_attack_chains(payload)

    def test_order_is_stable_for_same_input(self):
        payload = plan_payload(
            findings=[
                make_finding(target="b.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="a.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
            ],
            stages=[
                make_stage(id="s2", name="B", depends_on=["s1"]),
                make_stage(id="s1", name="A"),
            ],
        )
        first = self.service.plan_attack_chains(payload)
        second = self.service.plan_attack_chains(payload)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)

132	  `target`、`privilege`（仅 `user`、`admin`、`system`，权限由低到高）；transition 每项仅含 `id`、`from`、
133	  `to`（均引用已有会话，不得自指）、非空 `technique`、`cost`（1–100 的非布尔整数）；`starts` 是无重复会话
134	  id 的数组（id 必须存在）；goal 每项仅含 `id`、`target`、`min_privilege`（取值同 privilege）。先完成全部
135	  结构校验（结构错误、重复 id、未知引用、自指、非法 cost/privilege 均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有
136	  allow/deny 语义检查全部 session 与 goal 的规范化 target，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回
137	  局部路径。图可含环、跨目标边及同一对会话间的多条 transition。goal 仅由 target 规范化后相同且 privilege
138	  不低于 `min_privilege` 的会话满足。成功响应仅含与 `goals` 同序的 `paths`，每项含 `goal_id`、规范化
139	  `target`、`min_privilege`、`status`、`path`：不可达为 `status: "unreachable"`、`path: null`；可达为
140	  `status: "reachable"`，path 仅含 `start_session_id`、`end_session_id`、`total_cost`、`session_ids`、
141	  `transition_ids`，序列按行进顺序排列。起始会话直接满足目标时 total_cost 为 0、transition_ids 为空。最佳路径
142	  依次按总 cost、transition 数、start 输入位置、沿途 transition 输入位置序列、终点 session 输入位置由小到大
143	  决胜；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
144	- `POST /v1/requests/rate-limit-analyze`：离线分析请求观测中的限速超限与更换身份分摊流量的规避行为，不联网、
145	  不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`attempts`；`policy` 仅含 `window_ms` 与
146	  `max_requests`（均为正的非布尔整数）和 `group_by`（仅 `target` 或 `target_route`）；`attempts` 可为空
147	  数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、以 `/` 开头的非空 `route`、
148	  非空 `identity` 和非负非布尔整数 `timestamp_ms`，不接受多余字段。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、
149	  重复 `id`、非法值均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个尝试的规范化
150	  `target`，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。窗口起点为
151	  `floor(timestamp_ms / window_ms) * window_ms`；`group_by` 为 `target` 时按规范化目标与窗口分组，为
152	  `target_route` 时再按大小写敏感的 `route` 细分。组内总数大于 `max_requests` 才产生告警：组内至少两个
153	  `identity` 且每个身份的计数都不超过 `max_requests` 时 `kind` 为 `distributed_bypass`，否则为
154	  `direct_excess`。成功响应仅含 `alerts`，按窗口起点、目标首次出现位置、route 首次出现位置排序；每项仅含
155	  规范化 `target`、`route`（`target` 分组时为 `null`）、`window_start_ms`、`window_end_ms`（起点加
156	  `window_ms`）、`total_requests`、`identity_counts`（按身份首次出现顺序给出 `identity` 与 `count`）、
157	  `kind`、`attempt_ids`（按 `timestamp_ms` 升序，并列按输入顺序）。空 `attempts` 或无超限时返回空
158	  `alerts`；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
159	- `POST /v1/requests/schedule`：在请求发出前离线计算待执行请求的最早可用时间，不发送请求、不执行载荷、
160	  不联网、不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`requests`；`policy` 沿用限速分析的规则
161	  （`window_ms`、`max_requests` 为正的非布尔整数，`group_by` 仅 `target` 或 `target_route`）；
162	  `requests` 可为空数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、以 `/`
163	  开头的非空 `route`、非负非布尔整数 `earliest_ms` 和无重复请求 id 数组 `depends_on`，不接受多余字段。
164	  先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或数值非法、重复 `id`、依赖未知或重复、自依赖、依赖成环及
165	  非法范围规则均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个 `target` 的规范化形式，
166	  任一未获授权则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回部分计划；空 `requests` 仍校验 policy 与范围规则并
167	  返回空计划。编排采用稳定拓扑顺序（同层按输入位置靠前优先）；每个请求的候选时间取其 `earliest_ms` 与
168	  全部依赖项 `scheduled_ms` 的最大值，再寻找所属分组中尚未达到 `max_requests` 的最早固定窗口——窗口起点按
169	  `floor(timestamp_ms / window_ms) * window_ms` 计算，窗口已满则移至下一窗口起点。`group_by` 为 `target`
170	  时规范化目标共享限额，为 `target_route` 时按区分大小写的 `route` 分组。成功响应仅含 `schedule`，按
171	  `scheduled_ms` 升序排列，并列保持输入顺序；每项仅含 `id`、规范化 `target`、`route`、`scheduled_ms`、
172	  `window_start_ms` 及保持输入顺序的 `depends_on`。候选时间所在窗口有余位时执行时间为候选时间本身，
173	  被顺延则执行时间为下一窗口起点；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
174	- `POST /v1/exercises/safety-evaluate`：在动作执行前离线评估演练动作的安全阀决策，不联网、不执行动作、
175	  不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`actions`；`policy` 仅含布尔 `enabled`、正的非布尔
176	  整数 `window_ms` 与 `max_actions_per_target`、无重复动作种类的 `blocked_kinds` 数组；`actions` 可为空
177	  数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、动作种类 `kind`（仅
178	  `discovery`、`verification`、`exploitation`、`credential`、`privilege`）和非负非布尔整数
179	  `scheduled_ms`，不接受多余字段。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或数值非法、重复 `id`、
180	  `blocked_kinds` 重复及非法范围规则均返回 400 `invalid_request`；空 `actions` 仍校验 policy 与范围
181	  规则），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个动作的规范化 `target`，任一越界则整体返回 403
182	  `scope_violation`，不返回局部决策。通过后按输入顺序处理：`enabled` 为 `false` 时全部动作以
183	  `emergency_stop` 阻断；否则 `kind` 命中 `blocked_kinds` 时以 `blocked_kind` 阻断；其余动作按规范化
184	  `target` 计入固定窗口（窗口起点为 `floor(scheduled_ms / window_ms) * window_ms`），每目标每窗口放行
185	  前 `max_actions_per_target` 个，之后以 `action_limit` 阻断，前两类阻断不占配额。成功响应仅含
186	  `decisions` 与 `summary`：decisions 与 actions 同序，每项仅含 `id`、规范化 `target`、`kind`、
187	  `scheduled_ms`、`status`、`reason`（`allowed` 时 `reason` 为 `null`，`blocked` 时只能取上述三种
188	  值）；summary 仅含 `total`、`allowed`、`blocked` 三个一致计数。空 `actions` 返回空 decisions 与
189	  全零 summary；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
190	- `POST /v1/audit/build`：离线、确定性地构建演练审计链并计算完整性哈希，不联网、不执行动作、不持久化、
191	  不落盘。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`exercise_id`、`events`；`exercise_id` 为非空字符串，`events`
192	  可为空数组，每项仅含该链内唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、非空 `kind`、
193	  非空 `outcome` 和非负非布尔整数 `occurred_ms`，不接受多余字段；按输入顺序相邻两项的 `occurred_ms`
194	  不得递减。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或数值非法、重复 `id`、时间随输入顺序递减、非法
195	  范围规则均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个事件的规范化 `target`，
196	  任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。成功响应仅含 `audit`：含 `exercise_id`、
197	  `records`、`head_hash`。records 按输入顺序保留事件并写入规范化 `target`，再追加从 0 递增的
198	  `sequence`、`previous_hash` 与 `hash`；首项 `previous_hash` 为 64 个 `0`，其余各项取前一项的
199	  `hash`。`hash` 是把该记录去掉自身 `hash` 字段并加入 `exercise_id` 后，按 RFC 8785（JCS）规范化
200	  得到的 UTF-8 字节计算 SHA-256 的小写十六进制。空链 `head_hash` 为全零，否则取末项 `hash`；相同
201	  输入始终产生相同的记录与哈希。
202	- `POST /v1/audit/verify`：离线校验一次演练审计链的结构、范围与完整性，不联网、不执行动作、不持久化、
203	  不落盘。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny` 和 `audit`（与 build 成功响应的 `audit` 同形）。先严格校验字段、
204	  哈希格式（`previous_hash`、`hash`、`head_hash` 均须为 64 位小写十六进制）、事件 `id` 唯一性与
205	  `occurred_ms` 的非递减顺序：任何结构问题返回 400 `invalid_request`；再对全部规范化 `target` 执行
206	  既有 allow/deny 范围门禁，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回校验结果。随后依次核验
207	  每项的 `sequence`（须等于其下标）、`previous_hash`（首项为全零，其余等于前项 `hash`）、`hash`
208	  （按 build 相同方式重算）以及整体 `head_hash`。成功响应仅含 `verification`：`valid` 表示整体结果，
209	  `checked` 为连续通过的记录数，`head_hash` 为最后通过记录的 `hash`（无通过记录时为全零值）。全部
210	  通过时 `failure` 为 `null`；遇到首个不一致即停止，`valid` 为 `false` 且 `failure` 仅含 `index` 与
211	  `reason`，`reason` 唯一取 `sequence_mismatch`、`previous_hash_mismatch`、`hash_mismatch`、
212	  `head_hash_mismatch`，其中 `head_hash_mismatch` 的 `index` 等于 records 长度（空链为 0）。结构问题
213	  始终返回 400，链内容不一致返回 200 且 `valid` 为 `false`；相同输入始终产生相同结果。
214	- `POST /v1/web/security-analyze`：离线分析 HTTP 响应观测中的 CORS、Cookie 与安全响应头问题，不联网、
215	  不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`checks`、`observations`；`checks` 为非空、无重复的
216	  数组，元素仅可为 `cors`、`cookie`、`security_headers`；`observations` 可为空数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有
217	  目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、`scheme`（仅 `http` 或 `https`）和 `headers`（头名到非空
218	  字符串数组的对象，头名不区分大小写，同名头的所有值均参与判断）。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或值非法、重复
219	  `id` 或 check 均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个观测的规范化
220	  `target`，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。仅分析 `checks` 指定类别：
221	  `cors` 在 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` 含 `*` 且 `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` 含忽略大小写
222	  的 `true` 时产生 `cors_wildcard_credentials`（severity 为 high）；`cookie` 逐个检查
223	  `Set-Cookie`，https 响应缺少 `Secure` 产生 `cookie_missing_secure`、缺少 `HttpOnly` 产生
224	  `cookie_missing_httponly`（severity 均为 medium，属性名不区分大小写）；一个 Cookie 同时缺少两项
225	  时产生两个 finding，http 响应不检查 `Secure` 但仍检查 `HttpOnly`；`security_headers` 按
226	  HSTS、CSP、点击劫持、MIME 嗅探的固定顺序输出适用 finding：https 观测仅在某个
227	  `Strict-Transport-Security` 值按分号切分后含 `max-age` 指令、且等号右侧为大于零整数的纯 ASCII
228	  十进制数字时有效，否则产生 high 级 `hsts_missing_or_invalid`（http 不检查 HSTS）；不存在去除首尾
229	  空白后非空的 `Content-Security-Policy` 值时产生 medium 级 `csp_missing`；任一
230	  `X-Frame-Options` 值去空白后等于 `DENY` 或 `SAMEORIGIN`（大小写不敏感），或任一
231	  `Content-Security-Policy` 值含带非空参数的 `frame-ancestors` 指令时视为有点击劫持防护，否则产生
232	  medium 级 `clickjacking_unprotected`；任一 `X-Content-Type-Options` 值去空白后等于 `nosniff`
233	  时有效，否则产生 low 级 `nosniff_missing`；格式异常的头值仅视为无效，不使请求失败。成功响应仅含
234	  `findings`，按 observations、checks 顺序排列，security_headers 类内部按上述固定顺序，cookie 类再按
235	  `Set-Cookie` 值及 Secure、HttpOnly 顺序；每项仅含
236	  `observation_id`、规范化 `target`、`category`（即上述 finding 代码）、`severity`、
237	  `cookie_name`（cors 与 security_headers 为 `null`，cookie 类取首个等号前原文，不回显完整 Cookie）。空 `observations`
238	  或无命中返回空 `findings`，相同输入始终产生相同结果。
239	
240	## 验证
241	
242	```bash
243	PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
244	```
245	
246	当前基线刻意不包含资产发现、漏洞模板与攻击链编排的实现，以便后续任务从已冻结事实出发独立设计并验证这些能力。

# RedForge

这是一个面向渗透测试与攻防演练的渗透测试与攻防演练平台。长期目标是提供资产发现与指纹识别、端口与服务测绘、漏洞模板匹配、凭证探测、载荷生成、攻击链编排、授权边界强制和结果评分，把攻防演练沉淀为可复用平台。

仓库采用 Python，当前冻结基线只提供进程健康检查。后续能力必须通过独立题目逐步实现；每个题目都应定义可观察的公共行为、兼容边界和失败语义，不得依赖未公开内部 API。

## 启动

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m redforge.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

服务默认监听 `127.0.0.1:8080`，可通过 `REDFORGE_ADDR` 修改。`GET /healthz` 返回 JSON 健康状态。

## 接口

- `POST /v1/scope/evaluate`：以 `allow`/`deny` 规则评估 `targets` 的授权范围，纯本地判定。
- `POST /v1/vulnerabilities/match`：离线漏洞模板匹配。请求体含 `allow`、`deny`、`templates`、`observations`；
  先对全部观察目标执行范围评估（任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`），再把每个观察与每个模板按
  `all`/`any` 逻辑匹配，响应仅含 `findings`（按观察顺序、再按模板顺序），每项给出 `observation_id`、
  规范化 `target`、`template_id`、`name`、`severity` 和命中匹配器下标 `evidence`。
- `POST /v1/assets/fingerprint`：在本地把端口观测识别为服务资产，不联网、不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、
  `deny`、`fingerprints`、`observations`，后两项可为空数组；`observations` 的每项仅含 `id`（唯一非空字符串）、
  `target`（沿用既有目标语法，不得为通配符）、`port`（1–65535 的非布尔整数）、`transport`（仅 `tcp` 或
  `udp`）、`banner`（字符串）。`fingerprints` 的每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、非空 `name` 和 `service`、非布尔整数
  `priority`、值为 `all` 或 `any` 的 `logic`、非空 `matchers`。匹配器只能三选一：仅含 `ports`（无重复的
  1–65535 非布尔整数非空数组）、仅含 `transport`（`tcp` 或 `udp`），或仅含 `operator` 与非空 `value`（针对
  `banner`，operator 仅限 `equals`、`contains`、`regex`）；文本比较区分大小写，`regex` 使用搜索语义，非法
  表达式令请求无效。先完成全部结构校验（结构错误、重复 `id`、或规范化 `target`+`transport`+`port` 相同的重复
  端点均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再对每个观测的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403
  `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。通过后按 `all`（全部匹配器命中）/`any`（至少一个命中）判定指纹命中，
  多指纹命中时选择 `priority` 最大者，并列选择输入靠前者；evidence 为命中匹配器下标，按下标升序返回。成功响应
  仅含 `assets`：按目标首次出现顺序分组，每项含规范化 `target` 和 `services`；services 保持观测顺序，每项含
  `observation_id`、`port`、`transport`、`service`、`fingerprint_id`、`name`、`evidence`。未命中任何指纹时
  `service` 为 `"unknown"`，`fingerprint_id` 与 `name` 为 `null`，`evidence` 为空数组；空 `observations`
  返回空 `assets`；相同输入内容与顺序产生稳定结果。
- `POST /v1/assets/discover`：从授权种子与离线 DNS 记录确定性地推导主机与地址清单，不联网、不探测、不持久化。
  请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`seeds`、`records`、`max_depth`；`seeds` 是规范化后无重复的目标字符串数组，
  沿用既有主机名与单个 IP 语法，不接受网络段或通配符；`records` 可为空数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、
  主机名 `name`、仅限 `A`/`AAAA`/`CNAME` 的 `type` 和 `value`（A 对应 IPv4、AAAA 对应 IPv6、CNAME
  对应主机名，类型与地址版本不符令请求无效）。主机名与记录名沿用既有 IDNA、小写及去末尾点规范。
  `max_depth` 为 0 到 32 的非布尔整数。每个种子以深度 0 为起点按广度遍历：仅当当前目标是主机名且深度小于

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from .service import ScopeViolationError, Service

SCOPE_PATH = "/v1/scope/evaluate"
MATCH_PATH = "/v1/vulnerabilities/match"
FINGERPRINT_PATH = "/v1/assets/fingerprint"
DISCOVER_PATH = "/v1/assets/discover"
CONSOLIDATE_PATH = "/v1/findings/consolidate"
RETEST_PATH = "/v1/findings/retest"

AUDIT_BUILD_PATH = "/v1/audit/build"

WEB_SECURITY_PATH = "/v1/web/security-analyze"

    SCOPE_PATH,
    MATCH_PATH,
    FINGERPRINT_PATH,
    DISCOVER_PATH,
    CONSOLIDATE_PATH,
    RETEST_PATH,
    PLAN_PATH,
    EXPORT_PATH,
    CREDENTIALS_PATH,
    PAYLOADS_PATH,
    ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH,
    RATE_LIMIT_PATH,
    SCHEDULE_PATH,
    SAFETY_EVALUATE_PATH,
    AUDIT_BUILD_PATH,
    AUDIT_VERIFY_PATH,
    WEB_SECURITY_PATH,
)
MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024


def env_address() -> tuple[str, int]:
    raw = os.environ.get("REDFORGE_ADDR", "127.0.0.1:8080")
    host, _, port = raw.rpartition(":")
    if not host or not port.isdigit():
        raise SystemExit(f"invalid REDFORGE_ADDR: {raw!r}")
    return host, int(port)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    service = Service()

    def send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def send_error_json(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.send_json(status, {"error": {"code": code, "message": message}})

    def not_found(self) -> None:
        self.send_error_json(404, "not_found", f"no route for {self.path}")

    def reject_non_post(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        self.send_error(501, "Unsupported method (%r)" % self.command)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        if self.path == "/healthz":
            self.send_json(200, self.service.health())
            return
        self.not_found()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        if self.path == SCOPE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.evaluate_scope)
            return
        if self.path == MATCH_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.match_vulnerabilities)
            return
        if self.path == FINGERPRINT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.fingerprint_assets)
            return
        if self.path == DISCOVER_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.discover_assets)
            return
        if self.path == CONSOLIDATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.consolidate_findings)
            return
        if self.path == RETEST_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.retest_findings)
            return
        if self.path == PLAN_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.plan_attack_chains)
            return
        if self.path == EXPORT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.export_report)
            return
        if self.path == CREDENTIALS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_credentials)
            return
        if self.path == PAYLOADS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.generate_payloads)
            return
        if self.path == ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.compute_escalation_paths)
            return
        if self.path == RATE_LIMIT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_rate_limit)
            return
        if self.path == SCHEDULE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.schedule_requests)
            return
        if self.path == SAFETY_EVALUATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.safety_evaluate)
            return
        if self.path == AUDIT_BUILD_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.build_audit)
            return
        if self.path == AUDIT_VERIFY_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.verify_audit)
            return
        if self.path == WEB_SECURITY_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_web_security)
            return
        self.not_found()

    def _handle_json_post(self, handler) -> None:
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw_length is None or not raw_length.isdigit():
            self.send_error_json(
                400, "invalid_request", "missing or invalid Content-Length"
            )
            return
        length = int(raw_length)
        if length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
            # Do not drain an oversized body; drop the connection instead.
            self.close_connection = True
            self.send_error_json(413, "request_too_large", "body exceeds 1 MiB")
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(length)
        try:
            payload = json.loads(body)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", f"malformed JSON: {exc}")
            return
        try:
            result = handler(payload)
        except ScopeViolationError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(403, "scope_violation", str(exc))
            return
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", str(exc))
            return
        self.send_json(200, result)

    do_PUT = reject_non_post
    do_DELETE = reject_non_post
    do_PATCH = reject_non_post
    do_HEAD = reject_non_post

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None:
        """Silence per-request logging so recorded output stays stable."""


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="redforge.server", description="渗透测试与攻防演练平台")
    host, port = env_address()
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=host)
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=port)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), Handler)
    print(f"RedForge listening on http://{args.host}:{httpd.server_address[1]}", flush=True)
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

    service = Service()

    def send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def send_error_json(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.send_json(status, {"error": {"code": code, "message": message}})

    def not_found(self) -> None:
        self.send_error_json(404, "not_found", f"no route for {self.path}")

    def reject_non_post(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        self.send_error(501, "Unsupported method (%r)" % self.command)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        if self.path == "/healthz":
            self.send_json(200, self.service.health())
            return
        self.not_found()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        if self.path == SCOPE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.evaluate_scope)
            return
        if self.path == MATCH_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.match_vulnerabilities)
            return
        if self.path == FINGERPRINT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.fingerprint_assets)
            return
        if self.path == DISCOVER_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.discover_assets)
            return
        if self.path == CONSOLIDATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.consolidate_findings)
            return
        if self.path == RETEST_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.retest_findings)
            return
        if self.path == PLAN_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.plan_attack_chains)
            return
        if self.path == EXPORT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.export_report)
            return
        if self.path == CREDENTIALS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_credentials)
            return
        if self.path == PAYLOADS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.generate_payloads)
            return
        if self.path == ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.compute_escalation_paths)
            return
        if self.path == RATE_LIMIT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_rate_limit)
            return
        if self.path == SCHEDULE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.schedule_requests)
            return
        if self.path == SAFETY_EVALUATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.safety_evaluate)
            return
        if self.path == AUDIT_BUILD_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.build_audit)
            return
        if self.path == AUDIT_VERIFY_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.verify_audit)
            return
        if self.path == WEB_SECURITY_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_web_security)
            return
        self.not_found()

    def _handle_json_post(self, handler) -> None:
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw_length is None or not raw_length.isdigit():
            self.send_error_json(
                400, "invalid_request", "missing or invalid Content-Length"
            )
            return
        length = int(raw_length)
        if length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
            # Do not drain an oversized body; drop the connection instead.
            self.close_connection = True
            self.send_error_json(413, "request_too_large", "body exceeds 1 MiB")
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(length)
        try:
            payload = json.loads(body)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", f"malformed JSON: {exc}")
            return
        try:
            result = handler(payload)
        except ScopeViolationError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(403, "scope_violation", str(exc))
            return
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", str(exc))
            return
        self.send_json(200, result)

    do_PUT = reject_non_post
    do_DELETE = reject_non_post
    do_PATCH = reject_non_post
    do_HEAD = reject_non_post

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None:
        """Silence per-request logging so recorded output stays stable."""


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="redforge.server", description="渗透测试与攻防演练平台")
    host, port = env_address()
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=host)
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=port)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), Handler)
    print(f"RedForge listening on http://{args.host}:{httpd.server_address[1]}", flush=True)
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer

from redforge.server import Handler
from redforge.service import ScopeViolationError, Service


def make_finding(**overrides):
    finding = {
        "target": "app.example.com",
        "template_id": "tpl-1",
        "name": "Demo template",
        "severity": "high",
        "observation_ids": ["obs-1"],
        "sources": ["run-1"],
        "evidence": [0],
        "confidence": 80,
    }
    finding.update(overrides)
    return finding


def make_remediation(**overrides):
    remediation = {
        "id": "rem-1",
        "title": "Patch the thing",
        "guidance": "Apply vendor patch and retest.",
        "priority": 50,
        "template_ids": ["tpl-1"],
        "depends_on": [],
    }
    remediation.update(overrides)
    return remediation


def plan_payload(**overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com"],
        "deny": [],
        "findings": [make_finding()],
        "remediations": [make_remediation()],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


class RemediationPlanServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.service = Service()

    def plan(self, **overrides):
        return self.service.plan_remediations(plan_payload(**overrides))

    def test_ready_action(self):
        result = self.plan()
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["plans", "summary"])
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(list(plan), ["target", "actions", "uncovered_template_ids"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["target"], "app.example.com")
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], [])
        (action,) = plan["actions"]
        self.assertEqual(
            list(action),
            [
                "remediation_id",
                "title",
                "guidance",
                "status",
                "reason",
                "matched_template_ids",
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            action,
            {
                "remediation_id": "rem-1",
                "title": "Patch the thing",
                "guidance": "Apply vendor patch and retest.",
                "status": "ready",
                "reason": None,
                "matched_template_ids": ["tpl-1"],
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            result["summary"],
            {
                "targets": 1,
                "actions": 1,
                "ready": 1,
                "blocked": 0,
                "uncovered_findings": 0,
            },
        )

    def test_empty_findings_returns_empty_plans_and_zero_summary(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[],
            remediations=[make_remediation(), make_remediation(id="rem-2")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, {"plans": [], "summary": {
            "targets": 0,
            "actions": 0,
            "ready": 0,
            "blocked": 0,
            "uncovered_findings": 0,
        }})

    def test_empty_remediations_leaves_every_finding_uncovered(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
            ],
            remediations=[],
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["actions"], [])
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], ["tpl-1", "tpl-2"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["uncovered_findings"], 2)

    def test_template_id_match_is_case_sensitive(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[make_finding(template_id="TPL-1")],
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["actions"], [])
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], ["TPL-1"])

    def test_matched_template_ids_follow_finding_order_deduped(self):
        remediation = make_remediation(template_ids=["tpl-3", "tpl-1", "tpl-2"])
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-3"),
            ],
            remediations=[remediation],
        )
        (action,) = result["plans"][0]["actions"]
        # Catalog order does not matter; finding first-occurrence order wins.
        self.assertEqual(action["matched_template_ids"], ["tpl-2", "tpl-1", "tpl-3"])

    def test_uncovered_templates_keep_finding_order_deduped(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-9"),
            ],
            remediations=[make_remediation(template_ids=["tpl-1"])],
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], ["tpl-2", "tpl-9"])

    def test_dependency_not_applicable(self):
        # rem-1 matches no template on this target, so rem-2's direct
        # dependency never enters the plan; no missing dependency is invented.
        result = self.plan(
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="rem-1", template_ids=["absent"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-2", template_ids=["tpl-1"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-1"]),
            ]
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual([a["remediation_id"] for a in plan["actions"]], ["rem-2"])
        action = plan["actions"][0]
        self.assertEqual(action["status"], "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(action["reason"], "dependency_not_applicable")

    def test_dependency_blocked_propagates(self):
        result = self.plan(
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="rem-1", template_ids=["absent"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-2", template_ids=["tpl-1"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-1"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-3", template_ids=["tpl-1"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-2"]),
            ]
        )
        actions = result["plans"][0]["actions"]
        self.assertEqual(
            [(a["remediation_id"], a["status"], a["reason"]) for a in actions],
            [
                ("rem-2", "blocked", "dependency_not_applicable"),
                ("rem-3", "blocked", "dependency_blocked"),
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["blocked"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["ready"], 0)

    def test_ready_dependency_chain(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
            ],
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="rem-2", template_ids=["tpl-2"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-1"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-1", template_ids=["tpl-1"]),
            ],
        )
        actions = result["plans"][0]["actions"]
        self.assertEqual(
            [(a["remediation_id"], a["status"]) for a in actions],
            [("rem-1", "ready"), ("rem-2", "ready")],
        )

    def test_not_applicable_takes_precedence_over_blocked_dependency(self):
        # rem-2 has one blocked entered dependency and one dependency that
        # never enters; the spec names dependency_not_applicable first.
        result = self.plan(
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="rem-1", template_ids=["absent"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-3", template_ids=["absent"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-2", template_ids=["tpl-1"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-1", "rem-3"]),
            ]
        )
        action = result["plans"][0]["actions"][0]
        self.assertEqual(action["status"], "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(action["reason"], "dependency_not_applicable")

    def test_actions_follow_topological_layers(self):
        # Layer 0: a, b (both roots); layer 1: c depends on a and b.
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[make_finding(template_id="tpl-1")],
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="c", depends_on=["a", "b"]),
                make_remediation(id="a"),
                make_remediation(id="b"),
            ],
        )
        ids = [a["remediation_id"] for a in result["plans"][0]["actions"]]
        self.assertEqual(ids, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_same_layer_priority_descends_then_input_order(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[make_finding(template_id="tpl-1")],
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="low", priority=10),
                make_remediation(id="high", priority=90),
                make_remediation(id="mid", priority=50),
                make_remediation(id="high2", priority=90),
            ],
        )
        ids = [a["remediation_id"] for a in result["plans"][0]["actions"]]
        self.assertEqual(ids, ["high", "high2", "mid", "low"])

    def test_priority_only_breaks_ties_within_layer(self):
        # A lower-priority root still precedes a higher-priority child.
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[make_finding(template_id="tpl-1")],
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="child", priority=100, depends_on=["root"]),
                make_remediation(id="root", priority=1),
            ],
        )
        ids = [a["remediation_id"] for a in result["plans"][0]["actions"]]
        self.assertEqual(ids, ["root", "child"])

    def test_targets_keep_first_occurrence_order(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(target="b.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="a.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="b.example.com", template_id="tpl-2"),
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [plan["target"] for plan in result["plans"]],
            ["b.example.com", "a.example.com"],
        )

    def test_normalized_target_groups_findings(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(target="APP.Example.COM.", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="app.example.com", template_id="tpl-2"),
            ]
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["target"], "app.example.com")
        self.assertEqual(
            [a["remediation_id"] for a in plan["actions"]], ["rem-1"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], ["tpl-2"])

    def test_per_target_entry_is_independent(self):
        # Dependency enters on the first target but not the second; each
        # target's statuses are computed independently.
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(target="a.example.com", template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(target="a.example.com", template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(target="b.example.com", template_id="tpl-2"),
            ],
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="base", template_ids=["tpl-1"]),
                make_remediation(id="follow", template_ids=["tpl-2"],
                                 depends_on=["base"]),
            ],
        )
        plans = {plan["target"]: plan for plan in result["plans"]}
        self.assertEqual(
            [a["remediation_id"] for a in plans["a.example.com"]["actions"]],
            ["base", "follow"],
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            all(a["status"] == "ready" for a in plans["a.example.com"]["actions"])
        )
        (follow_b,) = plans["b.example.com"]["actions"]
        self.assertEqual(follow_b["remediation_id"], "follow")
        self.assertEqual(follow_b["status"], "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(follow_b["reason"], "dependency_not_applicable")
        self.assertEqual(
            result["summary"],
            {
                "targets": 2,
                "actions": 3,
                "ready": 2,
                "blocked": 1,
                "uncovered_findings": 0,
            },
        )

    def test_duplicate_finding_key_is_invalid(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(findings=[make_finding(), make_finding()])
        # The same key reached through different target spellings counts too.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[
                    make_finding(),
                    make_finding(target="APP.Example.COM."),
                ]
            )

    def test_scope_violation_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ScopeViolationError):
            self.plan(findings=[make_finding(target="evil.net")])
        with self.assertRaises(ScopeViolationError):
            self.plan(deny=["app.example.com"])

    def test_empty_findings_still_checks_catalog_and_scope_rules(self):
        # A cyclic catalog is a 400 even with no findings.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.plan_remediations(
                {
                    "allow": ["*.example.com"],
                    "deny": [],
                    "findings": [],
                    "remediations": [
                        make_remediation(id="a", depends_on=["b"]),
                        make_remediation(id="b", depends_on=["a"]),
                    ],
                }
            )
        # Invalid scope rules are a 400 too.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.service.plan_remediations(
                {
                    "allow": ["not a hostname!"],
                    "deny": [],
                    "findings": [],
                    "remediations": [],
                }
            )

    def test_structure_validated_before_scope_gate(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[
                    make_finding(target="evil.net"),
                    make_finding(target="evil.net"),
                ]
            )
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.plan(
                findings=[make_finding(target="evil.net")],
                remediations=[make_remediation(depends_on=["ghost"])],
            )

    def test_remediation_dependency_validation(self):
        bad_catalogs = [
            [make_remediation(depends_on=["rem-1"])],  # self reference
            [make_remediation(depends_on=["ghost"])],  # unknown id
            [make_remediation(depends_on=["a", "a"])],  # duplicate entry
            [make_remediation(id="a"), make_remediation(id="a")],  # dup id
            [
                make_remediation(id="a", depends_on=["b"]),
                make_remediation(id="b", depends_on=["a"]),
            ],  # cycle
        ]
        for remediations in bad_catalogs:
            with self.subTest(remediations=remediations):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    self.plan(remediations=remediations)

    def test_validation_errors(self):
        bad_payloads = [
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"allow": [], "deny": [], "findings": []},
            plan_payload(extra=1),
            plan_payload(allow="*.example.com"),
            plan_payload(deny=1),
            plan_payload(findings={}),
            plan_payload(findings="x"),
            plan_payload(findings=[None]),
            plan_payload(findings=[{"target": "app.example.com"}]),
            plan_payload(findings=[make_finding(extra=1)]),
            plan_payload(findings=[make_finding(severity="fatal")]),

import json

import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer

from redforge.server import Handler
from redforge.service import ScopeViolationError, Service


def make_finding(**overrides):
    finding = {
        "target": "app.example.com",
        "template_id": "tpl-1",
        "name": "Demo template",
        "severity": "high",
        "observation_ids": ["obs-1"],
        "sources": ["run-1"],
        "evidence": [0],
        "confidence": 80,
    }
    finding.update(overrides)
    return finding


def make_remediation(**overrides):
    remediation = {
        "id": "rem-1",
        "title": "Patch the thing",
        "guidance": "Apply vendor patch and retest.",
        "priority": 50,
        "template_ids": ["tpl-1"],
        "depends_on": [],
    }
    remediation.update(overrides)
    return remediation


def plan_payload(**overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com"],
        "deny": [],
        "findings": [make_finding()],
        "remediations": [make_remediation()],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


class RemediationPlanServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.service = Service()

    def plan(self, **overrides):
        return self.service.plan_remediations(plan_payload(**overrides))

    def test_ready_action(self):
        result = self.plan()
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["plans", "summary"])
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(list(plan), ["target", "actions", "uncovered_template_ids"])
        self.assertEqual(plan["target"], "app.example.com")
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], [])
        (action,) = plan["actions"]
        self.assertEqual(
            list(action),
            [
                "remediation_id",
                "title",
                "guidance",
                "status",
                "reason",
                "matched_template_ids",
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            action,
            {
                "remediation_id": "rem-1",
                "title": "Patch the thing",
                "guidance": "Apply vendor patch and retest.",
                "status": "ready",
                "reason": None,
                "matched_template_ids": ["tpl-1"],
            },
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            result["summary"],
            {
                "targets": 1,
                "actions": 1,
                "ready": 1,
                "blocked": 0,
                "uncovered_findings": 0,
            },
        )

    def test_empty_findings_returns_empty_plans_and_zero_summary(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[],
            remediations=[make_remediation(), make_remediation(id="rem-2")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(result, {"plans": [], "summary": {
            "targets": 0,
            "actions": 0,
            "ready": 0,
            "blocked": 0,
            "uncovered_findings": 0,
        }})

    def test_empty_remediations_leaves_every_finding_uncovered(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
            ],
            remediations=[],
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["actions"], [])
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], ["tpl-1", "tpl-2"])
        self.assertEqual(result["summary"]["uncovered_findings"], 2)

    def test_template_id_match_is_case_sensitive(self):
        result = self.plan(
            findings=[make_finding(template_id="TPL-1")],
        )
        (plan,) = result["plans"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["actions"], [])
        self.assertEqual(plan["uncovered_template_ids"], ["TPL-1"])

    def test_matched_template_ids_follow_finding_order_deduped(self):
        remediation = make_remediation(template_ids=["tpl-3", "tpl-1", "tpl-2"])

            findings=[
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-1"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-2"),
                make_finding(template_id="tpl-3"),

            remediations=[remediation],

        # Catalog order does not matter; finding first-occurrence order wins.
        self.assertEqual(action["matched_template_ids"], ["tpl-2", "tpl-1", "tpl-3"])

    def test_uncovered_templates_keep_finding_order_deduped(self):
        result = self.plan(

    def test_dependency_not_applicable(self):

        # dependency never enters the plan; no missing dependency is invented.
        result = self.plan(
            remediations=[
                make_remediation(id="rem-1", template_ids=["absent"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-2", template_ids=["tpl-1"],

    def test_dependency_blocked_propagates(self):

                make_remediation(id="rem-2", template_ids=["tpl-1"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-1"]),
                make_remediation(id="rem-3", template_ids=["tpl-1"],
                                 depends_on=["rem-2"]),
            ]
        )

        self.assertEqual(
            [(a["remediation_id"], a["status"], a["reason"]) for a in actions],

                ("rem-3", "blocked", "dependency_blocked"),

            [("rem-1", "ready"), ("rem-2", "ready")],

    def test_not_applicable_takes_precedence_over_blocked_dependency(self):
